rows.text: Statement of the Bank Board for the press conference following the monetary policy meeting
At its meeting today, the Bank Board of the Czech National Bank unanimously kept interest rates unchanged.
The two-week repo rate thus remains at 0.25%, the discount rate at 0.05% and the Lombard rate at 1%.
